CustomField.description: Last day of the last planned month when the plan runs past the native term (EndDate). Set by the UI2 services (Extend term, or an Order dated past the plan); blank while the plan matches the native term. The native ScheduleCount and EndDate stay unchanged.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The plan covers months up to this date. The native End Date does not change once the agreement is activated.
CustomField.label: Extended Through
